atAGlance: Nghêu hấp sả is clams steamed with lemongrass, usually with ginger, chili, basil, and a fragrant broth.
whatItIs: Nghêu hấp sả are clams steamed with lemongrass, chili, and a light briny broth. The broth should smell fresh, citrusy, and herbal.
howToEnjoy: Open the clams, sip a little lemongrass broth, and leave any clam that smells off or stays closed. Add chili only if you want heat over the clean broth.
howLocalsOrder: Order nghêu hấp sả as a shared ốc-shop plate. Ask for less chili and check freshness by the aroma when it arrives.
worthKnowing: Ốc and seafood shops often serve shellfish slowly, with broth, herbs, and chatter doing as much work as the clams.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
